C0023.title: Nearly 4,000 People Involved and 70 Million Yuan at Stake: Zibo Police Bust Fake Review Ring
C0023.summary: The Linzi Branch of the Zibo Public Security Bureau in Shandong dismantled a suspected illegal business operation ring that provided fake orders and fake reviews for e-commerce merchants. Since July 2022, the group had developed nearly 4,000 click farmers and merchants, generated more than 200,000 fake orders without genuine online-shopping services, and handled about 70 million yuan in transactions. Three principal suspects have been subjected to criminal coercive measures.
